data.name: Esa
data.gender_notes: Esa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Esa is the Arabic name for Jesus, a significant prophet in Islam. It means 'strong and powerful'. The name Esa carries the meaning “Strong and powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Esa usually hope their child will grow to embody strong and powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prophet Esa (Jesus) is considered a righteous prophet in Islam, known for his miracles and teachings.
data.etymology: Esa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong and powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Esa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إسا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم إسا يعني المسيح أو الرب، ويعتبر اسمه من أسماء الله الحسنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم إسا هو اسم علم عربي يُستخدم في اللغة العربية لوصف الشخص المسيحي أو الرب، وقد ورد اسمه في القرآن الكريم في سورة مريم آية 19، حيث قال تعالى: ((قُلْ اِنّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعاً أُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ عِندَ رَبِّي بَصيراً مُصَدِّقاً لِمُصَدِّقٍ وَنَذِيراً مِنَ النَّذِيرِينَ))، ويعد اسمه من أسماء الله الحسنة، وقد يكون اسماً للبنين، ويعد اسم إسا من أهم الأسماء في الإسلام، ويُعتبر اسمه ذا تأثير كبير في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: ایسا
in_urdu.meaning: ایسا نام اسے مسیح یا رب کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، یہ نام اسلام میں بھی اہمیت رکھتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایسا نام ایک عرب نام ہے جو مسیح یا رب کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، یہ نام کورئان میں بھی موجود ہے، جس میں ہے ((قُلْ اِنّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعاً أُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ عِندَ رَبِّي بَصيراً مُصَدِّقاً لِمُصَدِّقٍ وَنَذِيراً مِنَ النَّذِيرِينَ))، یہ نام اسلام میں بھی اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں بھی اس کا اہم مقام ہے

in_hindi.name: ईसा
in_hindi.meaning: ईसा नाम ईसा मसीह या ईश्वर के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, यह नाम भी हिंदू और मुस्लिम दोनों समुदायों में पवित्र माना जाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईसा नाम एक अरब नाम है जो ईसा मसीह या ईश्वर के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, यह नाम कुरआन में भी वर्णित है, जिसमें लिखा हुआ है ((कुल् इन्नि रसूलल्लाह इलयकुम जामीन अबयिनुलकुम इंदारब्बी बसीरा मसद्दिक लिमसद्दिक वेनजीरा मिन नजीरीन)), यह नाम हिंदू और मुस्लिम दोनों समुदायों में पवित्र माना जाता है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी इसका बहुत महत्व है

in_pashto.name: ایسا
in_pashto.meaning: ایسا نوم دا لوی الله یا مسیح لئې استعمال کیدیږي، دا نوم په افغانستان کې هم مهم ګړی ګڼل کېږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایسا نوم دا د افغانستان په ټولو ودانو لوی الله یا مسیح لئې استعمال کیدیږي، دا نوم کورئان کې هم راغلی دی، چې ((قُلْ اِنّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعاً أُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ عِندَ رَبِّي بَصيراً مُصَدِّقاً لِمُصَدِّقٍ وَنَذِيراً مِنَ النَّذِيرِينَ)) لیکل شوی دی، دا نوم په افغانستان کې هم مهم ګړی ګڼل کېږي او په پښتونو کې هم دا نوم لوی الله یا مسیح لئې ګڼل کېږي

in_english.name: Esa
in_english.meaning: The name Esa means the Messiah or the Lord, and it is considered a beautiful name in Islam
in_english.long_meaning: The name Esa is an Arabic name that means the Messiah or the Lord, and it is considered a beautiful name in Islam. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Maryam, verse 19, where it is said that Esa is a messenger of Allah to all people, making things clear to them, confirming what was sent down before him, and warning those who are bent on denying the truth. Esa is considered one of the most important names in Islam, and it has a significant impact on Islamic culture and tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Esa is highly regarded in the Islamic world, as Jesus is considered an important prophet in the religion. He is believed to be a messenger of God and a sign of God's mercy for humanity. Christians in the Middle East and other Islamic countries often use the name Esa along with Isa (Hebrew for Jesus) or the Arabic Iesa, to show their affinity with both their Christian and Islamic identities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Jesus is believed to have been born of the virgin Mary and sent as a Messiah and prophet to the people of Israel, confirming the earlier prophets and giving them a sign of God's power and mercy. He is considered a term of God's grace, a sign of His mercy to humanity, and a model of a good human character. Jesus' teachings and miracles, as mentioned in the Quran, continue to inspire Muslims to follow a path of compassion, healing, and equality. The name Esa thus carries the spiritual significance of being a reminder of the power and love of God and the importance of being a compassionate and virtuous human being.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Esa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of strong and powerful.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Born c. 5 BCE in Nazareth, Palestine, Esa is considered a prophet in Islam and Christianity. He is the son of Mary and the Messiah (or Christ) foretold in the Hebrew Bible. In the Islamic tradition, Esa is believed to have been taken up to heaven before his death.

trends: Esa is a common name among Muslims, especially in countries with large Muslim populations such as Pakistan, India, and Indonesia.
platforms: Social media, messaging apps, and email
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Esa remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
